items.prompt: Answer this one: Which words fit the situation politely?  (in this lesson: Kind Words, Right Place)
items.explanation: 'Good morning.' is a polite greeting, so it fits. 'Go away now!', 'Hurry up!', and 'I don't care!' are rude, so they do not fit a polite talk.

items.prompt: Answer this one: Which choice shows respect for the person speaking?  (in this lesson: Kind Words, Right Place)
items.explanation: 'Thank you.' shows you are grateful, and that is respectful. 'Go away now!', 'Hurry up!', and 'I don't care!' are rude.

items.prompt: Answer this one: Which sentence politely asks for help?  (in this lesson: Kind Words, Right Place)
items.explanation: 'Please help me.' has the polite word 'please', so it is a polite way to ask for help. The other choices are rude commands.

items.prompt: Answer this one: Which example uses a polite expression?  (in this lesson: Kind Words, Right Place)
items.explanation: 'Please help me.' uses the polite word 'please'. 'Hurry up!', 'I don't care!', and 'Go away now!' are not polite.

items.prompt: Answer this one: Which choice would sound respectful?  (in this lesson: Kind Words, Right Place)
items.explanation: 'Thank you.' sounds respectful because it shows you are grateful. Commands like 'Hurry up!' and 'Go away now!' are not respectful.
